Our Services
Full Groom
Complete haircut, bath, blowout, nails, and ears for a polished finish.
Small Animal Grooming
Gentle grooming for rabbits and guinea pigs.
Bath & Tidy
Perfect maintenance service between haircuts to keep your pet fresh.
Cat Grooming
Low-stress grooming for cats including seniors and anxious pets.
Why pet parents choose Kait’s Grooming
• Fear-free handling
• One-on-one appointments
• Experienced with difficult pets
• Calm luxury environment
• Trusted by local vets
A $25 deposit is required for all new clients to reserve an appointment and is applied toward your total. Please provide at least 24 hours’ notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations and no-shows will result in the deposit being forfeited for new clients. Existing clients may be subject to a cancellation fee.
By booking, you agree to Kait’s Grooming policies.
